Other Hormones
Characteristics and Function
Thyroid hormones
Modulate the tissue responsiveness to the catecholamines secreted by the SNS. A decrease in triiodothyronine lowers 
the response to SNS activity and diminishes adaptive thermogenesis. Women should be tested for hypothyroidism, 
particularly after menopause. Weight regain after weight loss may be a function of a hypometabolic state; energy  
restriction produces a transient, hypothyroid, hypometabolic state.
Visfatin
An adipocytokine protein secreted by visceral adipose tissue that has an insulin-like effect; plasma levels increase with 
increasing adiposity and insulin resistance.
Adrenomedullin
A new regulatory peptide secreted by adipocytes as a result of inflammatory processes.
